visual.heading: adidas Originals Shoes
visual.aboveTheFold: adidas Originals shoes: inspired by sport, created for style. From archival icons to cutting-edge kicks, find adidas Originals sneakers that go with your vibe.
visual.belowTheFold:
adidas Originals Shoes

Elevate any outfit with a pair of adidas Originals shoes. There are plenty of options to choose from, so why not grab a couple different styles. If you're looking for the classics, adidas Originals sneakers like the Samba, Gazelle or Stan Smith are full of brand heritage and easy to add to any look. With a range of colors to choose from, these adidas retro sneakers keep your look on point no matter where your day takes you. And with sizes for everybody in the family, you can get the whole crew outfitted in adidas Originals sneakers in every color of the rainbow.

If you're looking for easy-wearing style, look no further than adidas Originals shoes. There are the classic options like the SL 72 or the Campus that have been staples of the adidas Originals sneakers rotation for years. Or go for the more modern streetwear options like the various versions of the NMD shoes. These running-inspired sneakers add adidas Boost to the mix, giving you outstanding energy return to go with your head-turning style. And take it up a notch with brand collaborations with the likes of Y-3 or Liberty London. Check out adidas Originals shoes today, and find the right pair for your look.

faqList.question: What is the difference between adidas and adidas Originals?
faqList.answer:
adidas Originals is a sub-brand of adidas that centers on lifestyle, heritage and streetwear items, drawing inspiration from the brand’s rich history and iconic designs. You will find pieces in the Originals line that highlight vintage looks, classic silhouettes and the famous Trefoil logo. These products are made for everyday wear and are all about expressing personal style, connecting with culture and celebrating what makes adidas unique.

On the other hand, adidas performance products are engineered for sport and designed to meet the needs of athletes.

faqList.question: Are adidas Originals shoes good for running?
faqList.answer: adidas Originals shoes are made to go with everyday activities and everything in your streetwear rotation. adidas Originals sneakers and adidas running shoes for men and women differ in a few important ways. For instance, Originals are comfortably flat-soled rather than curved like a running shoe, and they don't offer the support or propulsion that come with running-dedicated footwear. If you're looking to do some serious running, check out our running shoes instead. adidas Originals are designed with lifestyle in mind, so they fit right in when you’re hanging out with friends, heading to class or running errands. They bring style and comfort to your daily routine but are not built for the high-impact demands of running. Running shoes are carefully engineered with features like responsive midsoles, structured support and curved outsoles to help guide your stride and return energy with every step.

faqList.question: What are adidas Originals shoes?
faqList.answer: adidas Originals encompasses a range of sneakers that are designed for everyday comfort and style, and rooted in adidas sport heritage. When you look at the Originals collection, you are seeing shoes inspired by classic moments and iconic designs from the brand’s history. Originals includes some of the most popular shoes, like the adidas Superstar sneaker, the Stan Smith and the Samba. Each shoe brings a vibe that connects old-school sport culture with modern fashion, so you can wear them with almost anything, from jeans to sweats. The shoes' modern design updates celebrate the sport past while looking to the style future. You get the best of both worlds, with sneakers that remind you of legendary athletes and timeless style, but also feel fresh.
